visualCharacteristics.purpose: static rendering of a transactional application form (sign-in, registration, account recovery, contact, claim); submission is not wired to a backend

contentPattern.structure: one row per field: label (end with * for required) | type (text, email, tel, number, password, date, search, url, textarea, select, radio, checkbox, checkboxes, toggle, submit, reset, button) | options (list or comma separated) or help text. Any other row is rich content (heading, instructions, links) kept in order. With the Image option, a picture-only row becomes a media column

reuseGuidance: Use for application, sign-in and account forms whose real behaviour lives in a server-side app. The block renders the fields so the page reads correctly and shows a notice on submit; link to the live app for real transactions. For lead capture beside intro copy use contact-form.
decisions: Submission is blocked client-side because the source form posts to a server-side app EDS cannot reproduce.
reCAPTCHA and app-only widgets are not reproduced.
